name: Livestock
source: Livestock Feeds Plc statement of profit or loss for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), six months column, thousands scaled to naira. EPS as printed in kobo converted to naira and consistent with 3,000,000,000 ordinary shares. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | CRON 20260929_003746: Income Tax sign normalised to the dataset convention, the charge stored positive and a credit negative, on 5 period(s), so that the rendered Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit. The required sign is fixed by the direction of the move from Profit Before Tax to Net Profit in the stored rows, and the stored magnitude already agreed with that move. CRON 2026-10-06: EPS for FY2020 derived as Net Profit divided by shares outstanding (2999999418 shares per static_data/ngx_pdfs/LIVESTOCK.pdf, page 49 ('Issued Share C). The 5 already-stored EPS figure(s) in this file reproduce that identity within 3 percent, and none contradict it. | CRON 20261117: 9M 2026 column from the Livestock Feeds Plc statement of profit or loss for the period ended 30 September 2026, NGX doclib, nine months to September 2026 column, printed in N thousand and stored as absolute naira. Revenue 22,391,078; cost of sales 18,194,120; gross profit 4,196,958; other operating income 123,850; selling and distribution 288,872 plus administrative expenses 1,308,199 gives operating expenses 1,597,071; operating profit 2,723,737; net finance cost 1,264,742 is finance costs 1,267,653 less finance income 2,911; profit before tax 1,458,996; income tax 206,094; profit for the period 1,252,902; basic EPS printed 41.76 kobo, stored as 0.4176 naira. Ties exactly on both identities.

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored with a negative sign, which broke the printed identity Operating Profit (EBIT) - Net Finance Costs = Profit Before Tax; the magnitude is unchanged and the column now carries the positive cost sign the identity requires

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.withhold_reason: withheld: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses does not equal the filed Operating Profit and the file carries no extra line that explains the gap, so the operating expenses (or operating profit) cannot be established from the statement; an honest blank beats a figure that fails its own arithmetic
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedFrom: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedBasis: identity holds in every other period of this same file

rows.label: EPS
rows.formula: Net Profit / shares outstanding (2999999418 shares, issued share capital (per the company's annual report))

unitGuard.reason: unit guard: the EPS row for 9M 2026 read 417.6 against 0.417634 for that period's net profit divided by the shares on file, a factor of 999.9, which is the 1000x multiple of a per-share figure printed in a sub-unit (kobo / cents / a thousandth). Normalised to 0.4176, the unit the price is quoted in.

rows.unitGuardBasis: factor = stored EPS / (the same period's net profit / shares on file); a factor within 15% of a power of ten (or its reciprocal) whose corrected value lands within 2.0x of the triangle is a UNIT error and is normalised; a stored cell of the opposite sign to the period's net profit whose magnitude is beyond 5.0x is WITHHELD with both figures named; every other cell is left exactly as filed

marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding
reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2023; the operating expenses for those periods are withheld (see the row note). Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2024: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged.
derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
